request: JBH-74 section 2: create the jbh-notification Quarkus service in this repo. Move jbh-personal-finance/jbh-notification/jbh-notification-contracts and jbh-notification-infra here, add a runnable app module modelled on jbh-personal-finance/jbh-z-assembly (port 7778, Consul name jbh-notification, Dockerfile). Remove the preferences call (DirectPreferencesAdapter, UserPreferencesPort, jbh-preferences-contracts): a request locale wins, otherwise default 'es'. Depend on com.jbh:jbh-commons-lib:1.0.0-SNAPSHOT from its new repo. Datasource stays on jbh_finance, schema notifications. Add publish (contracts) and image workflows, README.md, CLAUDE.md. Ticket: JBH-74 (naming only; do NOT move it in Linear — jbh-leader owns status). Stop after the proposal is written, validated, design briefing shown, and committed; do not dispatch Step 5 workers until jbh-leader sends "go section 2". Do not push.
